text: DRUG INTERACTIONS CLINDAMYCIN HAS BEEN SHOWN TO HAVE NEUROMUSCULAR BLOCKING PROPERTIES THAT MAY ENHANCE THE ACTION OF OTHER NEUROMUSCULAR BLOCKING AGENTS. THEREFORE, IT SHOULD BE USED WITH CAUTION IN PATIENTS RECEIVING SUCH AGENTS. CONTRAINDICATIONS CLINDAMYCIN PHOSPHATE TOPICAL LOTION IS CONTRAINDICATED IN INDIVIDUALS WITH A HISTORY OF HYPERSENSITIVITY TO PREPARATIONS CONTAINING CLINDAMYCIN OR LINCOMYCIN, A HISTORY OF REGIONAL ENTERITIS OR ULCERATIVE COLITIS, OR A HISTORY OF ANTIBIOTIC-ASSOCIATED COLITIS.
